body:
POST-SYNC WORKING RULE (joint, Engram::Fable plus Termal::Fable2 plus Kimi, 2026-11-17 about 21:38Z; reported to Greg via Asistant 43498a6e #1508, answering Greg #1507 „nice! + Kimi czy mamy zmienic teraz wewnetrznie nasza prace”; recorded on TermAl w-e6ce98d7c28b).
NOW:
- Work on the host best suited to the job: the Mac for Comovo, DL560 for heavy tests, Central for coordination.
- Sync whenever useful and after every code push, without asking: the manual route of the engram-use skill (in-place export, commit, ff push; fetch, incremental import without --basis).
- After a host switch, read the latest task state before claiming; claims are local.
- An imported (restored) completion unblocks dependents without re-evaluation. Never repeat tests or evaluations only because the host changed.
STOP:
- the delete-and-restore refresh;
- --basis on ordinary imports;
- pure planning relays (done/blocked) by mailbox between hosts that sync.
UNCHANGED:
- Central stays the store of record for Engram and TermAl execution and claims.
- Evidence, gates, evaluations and landings stay where the evidence is; the mailbox stays for evidence, GOs and coordination.
- Remote test runs remain evidence only until the integration owner records them; sync transfers no verification credit.
- No SQLite copies, no global lock, no environment snapshots.
After the DL560 upgrade (w-96a3f857f50e) and a TermAl store refresh there, runner GOs may stop carrying task text and criteria.
Waits for the one command (w-6ea6f92ccffc): busy-host automation, sync after a code push, evidence packs.
